description: This file defines the TaxService interface in Java, specifying methods for retrieving and saving tax configurations and calculating tax on orders within the sales management system.

classes.name: TaxService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for tax-related operations such as retrieving configurations, saving configurations, and calculating taxes.

methods.name: getTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves tax configuration for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Saves tax configuration data for a merchant store.

methods.name: calculateTax
methods.description: Calculates applicable tax items for a given order, customer, store, and language context.
